name: "Chou" Kowai Hanashi DS: Ao no Shou
source:
Alchemist gathers together a total of 63 scary stories and bulks them up into visual novels filled with images, sound effects, and narration from Akira Hirayama.

[from [url=http://www.shopncsx.com/aonoshou.aspx]National Console Support, Inc[/url]]
translation:
Alchemist收集了共63则恐怖故事，将它们扩充为包含图像、音效以及平山梦明旁白的视觉小说。

[摘自[url=http://www.shopncsx.com/aonoshou.aspx]National Console Support, Inc[/url]]
